chat.text: Run a small pilot of a task-specific Core/Page mastermind using Servex's worktree workflow. Map the Page class and its owned subsystems from the readme chain, then report a concise first-step plan and how the mastermind will keep work moving. Use OpenRouter only to preserve Anthropic quota; do not edit code during this pilot. Track this request on the card.

message.text: Scope clarification: the Page mastermind is a durable domain expert for `public/framework/core/Page/` and its subsystems: page creation/structure and live-tail behavior. Its working directory should be the Page module, with the root-to-module readme chain loaded automatically at startup. This is a real pilot of the mastermind workflow, not merely a page-system document proposal.

Launch attempt outcome: Servex rejected this voice smart-assistant session's `spawn_agent` call with `may not spawn a task-mastermind: a worker may spawn only a minion or a helper.` No agent or worktree was created. This confirms the current permission boundary blocks the smart assistant from launching the requested mastermind; it must be handed to an authorized parent/manager or the architecture changed through the proper system owner.

Owner approved the handoff. I attempted to route the task to `mastermind-servex`, but this smart-assistant session is not authorized to message that coordinator directly. I left a note on `/framework/servex/` for the authorized coordinator to pick up. No launch/worktree has yet been verified.

Verified blocker: Servex `Policy.kind()` classifies `session-smart-v-yxnts4l` as a generic worker because it matches none of the known role prefixes (`Servex/agents/policy.js:42`). `Policy.spawn()` therefore applies the worker rule and refuses `task-mastermind` (`policy.js:124`). This is a deterministic role-policy mismatch, not an AI judgment. The smart assistant needs a narrow ability to launch task masterminds while staying unable to spawn/manage minions. I left this finding and requested an authorized Servex policy fix on `/framework/servex/`.

Owner explicitly says identity should not be spoofed by prompt. The right fix is in trusted caller classification/policy: recognize the smart voice-session role and allow it to spawn only `task-mastermind` (with tests); keep ordinary workers limited to minion/helper, keep the assistant unable to spawn minions/managers, and ensure the raw role/alias path cannot bypass that restriction. Please have the authorized Servex owner implement and test this in a clean worktree; do not edit the dirty shared tree.

Owner explicitly authorized fixing the spawn policy. Exact safe behavior requested: trusted smart voice sessions may launch only `task-mastermind`; they must not gain minion/helper/manager spawning. Generic workers remain minion/helper-only. Add policy tests for both allowed and denied paths; caller role must come from Servex-trusted context, never prompt text. This session cannot edit Servex or spawn the needed task mastermind, so the `/framework/servex/` page note requests the authorized Servex mastermind to implement it in a clean worktree.

Owner clarifies the desired fix is broader than this Page pilot: smart assistant needs a safe general ability to launch appropriate independent agents, particularly masterminds that own tasks and can manage their workers; it should not manage minions itself. Current state remains: root cause verified in policy.js; no policy code change, agent launch, or worktree yet. The requested Servex policy note is pending response.
